summary: Classic marble shooting puzzle with no ads, rich levels and kingdom adventure.
description: Marble Kingdom is a classic marble shooting puzzle game with relaxing gameplay, colorful scenes, and plenty of challenging levels. Start your adventure in a mysterious kingdom filled with secret paths, ancient treasures, and exciting marble puzzles. Aim carefully, match colors, create combos, and clear the board before the marbles reach the end! How to Play: 1. Shoot marbles to match three or more of the same color. 2. Tap the launcher to switch between the current marble and the next one. 3. Use combos and power-ups to boost your score. 4. Clear all marbles before they reach the final point. Features: - Ad-free gameplay - Classic marble shooting puzzle fun - Easy to learn, but challenging to master - Many levels and secret maps to explore - Smooth controls and colorful HD graphics - Useful props such as arrows, bombs, and more - Relaxing yet strategic gameplay for all players Explore the Marble Kingdom, challenge your skills, and enjoy a timeless puzzle adventure. Thanks to every player for your support. Your feedback and suggestions are always welcome!
